title: glosa review report
description: tier: Dr (specified; independently unreviewed). Implements FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §4.3 (vendor-neutral cross-vendor execution / templates/knowledge/cross_vendor_review_packet.md's `review_report.yaml` output shape) and §7.3 (Bounded-Judge Law: an untiered verdict is invalid, verdict_tier is REQUIRED and uses the SIX-value tier ladder, chair ruling C4 -- not the four-value set an earlier draft, S10, shipped). Field renamed from the packet template's `independence_level` to `independence_class` to match chair ruling C1 ('independence_class is the string ladder I0..I5 in EVERY schema that carries it -- claim card, evidence relation, review report, citation card, kg edge'). Namespace https://glosa.example/ is a placeholder.

reviewer_identity.description: MC-01: must differ from the artifact's maker_id and approver_id -- a string-inequality check across three separate fields is NOT expressible in JSON Schema draft-07 (kernel-enforced only, §3.3 rule 5's twin for review_report).

verdict_tier.description: Bounded-Judge Law (§7.3): a review_report with no verdict_tier is invalid and cannot back any tested: entry, regardless of independence level. SIX values (chair ruling C4).

approver_kind.description: MUST-7 (ARCH_integrity.md F1 / kernel/glosa_kernel.py's _human_approver_error_for_review): names whether this check was actually performed by a human or an AI identity. Required, and must be 'human', once mc_level reaches L5 or independence_class is I5 (FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.1's Class-5-never-substitutes-for-I5 rule -- no AI reviewer_identity, however cross-vendor-decorrelated, satisfies an I5/L5 requirement).

allOf.description: MUST-7: mc_level L5 or independence_class I5 requires a human check -- approver_kind must be 'human', not merely present (Class-5-never-substitutes-for-I5, FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §7.1).
